description: This source file defines the PaymentProviderRegistry class, which manages registration and retrieval of PaymentAuthorizationProvider implementations mapped to PaymentProvider identifiers within a payment service module.

classes.name: PaymentProviderRegistry
classes.description: A registry component that maintains a mapping of PaymentProvider to their respective PaymentAuthorizationProvider implementations, ensuring singleton-like management and providing access control.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Retrieves the PaymentAuthorizationProvider associated with the specified PaymentProvider, throwing an exception if no such provider is registered.
